published_source.paper: Shenwei Huang, Improved Complexity Results on k-Coloring P_t-Free Graphs, European Journal of Combinatorics 51 (2016) 336-346
imported_only: the theorem that H P_t-free for t>=6 implies G_{H,I} P_t-free
H=C7 for the P7-free four-coloring construction
published_source.not_imported: NP-hardness is not used as a carrier lower bound or hardness promotion.

clauses: one positive clause for every 3-subset of optional variables
for v_i, k^2+i copies of positive marker clause (x1,x3,v_i)
family.underlying_graph: exact Huang G_{C7,I_k}; no Janus-added graph edge

seed_and_root_canonicalization.B0_competing_survivors: NONE: every Y vertex meeting residual Y0 has the same source list {2,3,4}.

root_source_state.generic_X_D: source list {1,2}; they see seed colors 3 and 4 from h1_1,h1_6.
root_source_state.generic_U: source list {2,3,4}; every U sees seed literal x2=1.
root_source_state.Y0: all C-type vertices in core/marker clauses plus distinguished h1_4 that are anticomplete to S; Y0 is stable.
root_source_state.source_vi: PASS with unique list {2,3,4} on Y intersect N(Y0).

exact_after_X0.persistent_clause_U_side: ordinary U has A={3,4} because X0 vertices ~x2=2,d2=1 are complete to every U

authorized_forcing.choice: arbitrary F subseteq {v_1,...,v_k}; force positive literal x(v_i)=1 for i in F
source_delta: ~v_i becomes the unique source singleton color 2 and is deterministically promoted to X0
all C-type occurrences of v_i move from residual Y0=[4] to dynamic Y={2,3,4}
d_i remains live with source list {1,2}
ordinary U source lists remain {2,3,4}; their exact A remains {3,4} once root X0 is present
authorized_forcing.B0_provenance: vacuous in every descendant because Y intersect N(Y0) retains only source list {2,3,4}
authorized_forcing.explicit_extension: for all F: d_i=x_i=1, ~x_i=2; every C-type=2; U positions 1,3,5=3 and position 6=4. This extends seed, root X0, optional forces and optional X0 promotions.

QALL_profiles.reason: live U vertices are complete to all live X/D vertices; every residual C carrier attaches to its literal/D and adjacent U vertices; d_i and the negative literal side remain after optional forcing.
QALL_profiles.canonical_signature: for optional d_i, (# residual C-carrier neighbors,# dynamic C-type neighbors)=(q_i,0) if unforced and (0,q_i) if forced
QALL_profiles.new_seed_identity_independence: signature does not use growing N(v)∩S_new identities or forcing-order history

four_color_future_activity.C1_exact_failure: persistent d1 has A={1,2}; persistent ordinary U has A={3,4}; no common palette of size <=3 contains all active exact lists
four_color_future_activity.R2_color_1: d1,d3 are permanent nonadjacent vertices colored 1 in the explicit witness
four_color_future_activity.R2_color_3: U-position-1 vertices in two different non-distinguished clauses are permanent nonadjacent vertices colored 3
four_color_future_activity.R2_color_4: U-position-6 vertices in two different non-distinguished clauses are permanent nonadjacent vertices colored 4

component_compilation.C3: one [4]-selector with the same dynamic neighborhood D_C
component_compilation.C7_persistence: after C3, every non-distinguished clause still contains an induced C7, with each residual C-position represented by its selector and each nonresidual C-position represented by the dynamic vertex

dependency_support.optional_hyperedges: one clause support for every 3-subset of optional variables
dependency_support.partition_property: every nontrivial split of optional variables is crossed by an exact clause support
dependency_support.meaning: no disconnected support factorization and no bounded singleton/pair/bounded-running-intersection variable interface under the frozen carriers
dependency_support.firewall: not a lower bound against unknown algebraic representations

C1.reason: exact persistent lists {1,2} and {3,4} have union [4]

C2.reason: future-complete Q_ALL remains one connected block

C3.reason: singleton components compile to constant selectors while the K_k clause/variable support and 2^k profile injection survive

reason: optional dependency primal K_k has no singleton/pair separator and running-intersection width grows as k-1
frozen bicameral bucket-specific carriers are not instantiated merely by graph similarity
no guarded bounded-output certificate satisfying its explicit guard is established

C5.reason: compiled graph contains induced C7; interval graphs are chordal and permutation graphs are perfect

C6.reason: no source-bound constant mim-width/sim-width theorem plus polynomially supplied decomposition is bound to this family; E2 forbids width optimization/recognition as a substitute

C7.reason: compiled unresolved core contains induced C7 and is not bipartite

C8.reason: complete 3-uniform optional support has primal K_k, so every nontrivial optional-variable split is crossed by a clause gadget; no frozen secondary exact bounded-interface decomposition is certified

C9.reason: induced C7 contains induced P5, so active lifecycle is not certified P5-free
